archives.coverage: Both raw session journals, frozen materialization, claims, native tokenization, source snapshots, private partial and complete analysis.
Existing64 review evidence plus additive corrected delivery; protected records copied as opaque bytes, no mapping content inspected or published.

verification: Resolved explicit sources and backup parent; refused any preexisting archive target or source reparse point. SHA256 checked every decompressed archive member against its source, checked entry counts, and rehashed sources afterward. No overwrite or deletion.
privacy: Archive files are private, outside the repository and excluded from Git. This public receipt contains only path-level provenance, counts and hashes, not participant text or review keys.
limitations: Same-volume local preservation only; not off-device disaster recovery, remote backup, encryption assurance or publication. Model weights/full corpus are not included in these incremental archives. Earlier baseline preservation remains separately recorded.
